load_object_library_from_folder: load an ObjectLibrary from a folder path by reading instance.json and building id-to-name mappings
get_object_id_to_name_dict: get the object id to name dictionary mapping object IDs to instance names for dynamic objects
get_object_name_to_id_dict: get the object name to id dictionary mapping instance names back to their object IDs
get_headset_id_to_name_dict: get the headset id to name dictionary mapping headset IDs to their instance names
get_cad_asset_path: get the file path to a CAD asset GLB file given an object library folder and object ID
